name: Johanan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Johanan spoke secretly to Gedaliah, offering to kill Ishmael himself so that Gedaliah would not be slain and the gathered remnant scattered.
Gedaliah forbade Johanan to do it, saying he spoke falsely of Ishmael, and refused to believe the plot.

note.label: Jeremiah 40: Jeremiah Set Free and Gedaliah Made Governor

points: All the people Ishmael had taken captive were glad to see Johanan, turned about, and returned to him, but Ishmael escaped from Johanan with eight men and went to the Ammonites.

note.label: Jeremiah 41: Ishmael Murders Gedaliah and Johanan Recovers the Remnant

points: Johanan took the whole remnant he had recovered from Ishmael, the mighty men of war, the women, the children, and the eunuchs, and departed to dwell near Bethlehem on the way toward Egypt.

note.label: Jeremiah 41: Ishmael Murders Gedaliah and Johanan Recovers the Remnant

points: All the captains, Johanan, Jezaniah, and all the people from the least to the greatest came to Jeremiah the prophet before going into Egypt and begged him to pray to the Most High for them, that they might know the way to walk and what to do.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: When Jeremiah finished speaking all the words of the Most High, Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men told him he spoke falsely and called him a lying prophet; pride is destruction according to the scriptures.

note.label: Jeremiah 43: The Proud Men Reject the Word and Flee to Egypt

cases.name: Johanan and the remnant that went down to Egypt
cases.charge: Asking Jeremiah to pray for the way wherein they should walk, swearing to obey the voice of the Lord whether it were good or evil, and then calling the prophet a liar and going into Egypt against the commandment; burning incense to the queen of heaven in the land of Egypt
